card.name: Parenthesis after neovascular AMD
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis right after "Neovascular" or "Age-Related Macular Degeneration" or "AMD" in eye-drug labels. It comes just before "wet" or the abbreviation AMD/nAMD.

modes.label: After the full disease name
modes.description: Parenthesis opens after Age-Related Macular Degeneration, introducing the abbreviation AMD or nAMD.
modes.example: 2.2 Neovascular (wet) Age-Related Macular Degeneration<< (>>nAMD) The recommended dose for V

modes.label: After Neovascular or AMD
modes.description: Parenthesis opens right after the word neovascular or AMD, introducing wet or a section number.

card.writes: It promotes age-related words and suppresses disease words, which fits the term Age-Related Macular Degeneration.
card.plain: It fires on the bracket that follows the eye condition name wet AMD, just before the label gives its abbreviation.
